scripts.css: tailwindcss -i ./css/input.css -o ./css/utilities.css --minify && cat css/utilities.css css/site.components.css > css/site.css && cat css/a11y.css >> css/site.css
scripts.build: npm run css && python3.14 scripts/build-curacao-site.py && python3.14 scripts/generate-book-pages.py
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run check && wrangler deploy
scripts.bookings:migrate:test: wrangler d1 migrations apply curacao-bookings-test --remote --config workers/bookings/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.bookings:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply curacao-bookings-prod --remote --config workers/bookings/wrangler.prod.jsonc
